general_information.name: IT’S BRIAN CALLOWAY.
general_information.gender: I’m a man, I think. Is that what you mean?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve been drinking every night to get to sleep, and my mood’s been pretty low. I’ve also been feeling guilty and like I’m letting people down.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to cut down the drinking, sleep without it, and not feel like such a burden.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: I’ve done some motivational interviewing before, back in 2023.; In 2023.; About 6 sessions, give or take.

medications.past_medication_details: Past medication 1: Name Or Description: Mirtazapine.; Dose: 30 mg nightly.; Dates Or Duration: I took it for about 4 months in 2023.; Discontinuation Reason: It was stopped because I put on weight.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My father.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Alcohol use disorder.; Additional Details: No, he was never treated for it.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Mostly spirits and beer.; Quantity or frequency: Something like eight standard drinks most evenings. I’ve been doing that for a while.; Duration: About two years at that level.
substance_use.nonmedical_nicotine_use: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Cigarettes.; Quantity or frequency: About 20 a day.; Duration: About 15 years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Portland Distribution.; Job Title: Warehouse supervisor.; Dates: 2009 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Scarborough. It was kind of a difficult home, with my father’s drinking.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I left school around 18 and started work right away, pretty much.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married, about 22 years now, but it’s pretty strained at the moment.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to be sober and useful to my family again.
